appStoreAccessibilityNutritionLabels.description: Accessibility support declared for Leela Chakra Ai on the App Store product page.

evidence: All interactive controls have accessibilityRole and accessibilityLabel.
Game board cells expose plane, cell number, and feature labels.
Dice, turn indicator, roll result, and win celebration are announced.
Modals use accessibilityViewIsModal and trap focus via onRequestClose.
Text component applies scaled fontSize/lineHeight to all headings.
Buttons, tabs, cards, and header adapt line counts at accessibility sizes.
Scrollable containers used throughout so large text remains reachable.
useReducedMotion hook listens to system setting.
Dice roll, WinCelebration particles, Gem movement, and BoardLegend modal respect Reduce Motion.
Turn indicator and roll announcement skip haptic/visual fade when enabled.
High contrast theme available in Settings with black/yellow/white palette.
High contrast GameBoard uses #FFFFFF on #000000 and #000000 on #FFFF00.
Active BoardLegend symbol gets a black border in addition to color.
Game board cells announce snake head, arrow base, and final cell independently of color.
Current/previous/next cells differ by border/background, not only hue.
BoardLegend symbols differ by shape (circle, diamond, arrow, snake).
App supports system light/dark appearance via useColorScheme.
Theme selector allows explicit light/dark/system override.

notClaimed: Voice Control: not yet tested end-to-end.
Captions: audio content is limited; no captions are provided.
Audio Descriptions: no video content requires descriptions.
